checkinGuide.preview: Check-in screen example, not your health result
checkinGuide.slide1Desc: Daily check-ins help Asinu record your wellness, detect health trends early, and notify family members when care is needed.
checkinGuide.slide2Desc: When you feel healthy and normal, simply tap the large “I'm fine” button to complete your check-in in just a few seconds.
checkinGuide.slide3Desc: On Home, tap “I'm noticing unusual symptoms”, then choose how you feel so Asinu can ask follow-up questions and record your condition.
checkinGuide.slide4Desc: Choose the areas that feel uncomfortable, tap Continue, then answer the relevant questions. You can select multiple areas or add your own description.
checkinGuide.slide5Desc: Review the recorded information and next steps. Tap Read check-in results again to hear the Asinu Tuan Anh voice. If audio is unavailable, you can still read the content and try listening again. This is guidance, not a diagnosis.
